texts: Tom. Good. Neighborhood Watch Captain, potluck committee chair. Forty RSVPs. Thirty-nine dishes. One bread guy.
Every pilot light on 2nd Avenue went out at noon. Every one. Including mine. I had a casserole IN there.
They said it's the weekend. I said it's the POTLUCK. They hung up. I've filed a report. With myself.
The barn has been chained up for sixty years. Here, take the committee key. I'm the committee.
We're closing the boulevard for the potluck tables, and I need the bread by six.
Forty loaves. Six o’clock. On the dot. Potluck committee report: we're a success.
The gumbo is hot. The casserole is hot. Everything is hot. I'd like it noted.
